Quality and compliance

A quality system that supports every clinical study.

UNAMIS maintains controlled procedures, manuals, forms and records to support consistent, traceable clinical operations and participant protection.

Controlled institutional documentation
Applicable documentation may be reviewed during feasibility, site selection, activation, monitoring or audit, according to the protocol, sponsor or CRO requirements and applicable confidentiality agreements.

System capabilities

Processes supported by our quality system

The public description below summarizes the scope of the system without exposing internal document codes or controlled records.

Institutional management
  • Feasibility assessment, proposals, negotiation and contracting.
  • Study activation, responsibilities and delegation.
  • Operational contingency planning and institutional conduct.
Quality and oversight
  • Standard operating procedures and document control.
  • Internal and external monitoring and quality reviews.
  • Deviation management and corrective actions.
Participant protection
  • Informed consent and special consent situations.
  • Medical records, clinical notes and safety documentation.
  • Adverse-event management and follow-up.
Study coordination
  • Monitoring visits, CRF completion and study communication.
  • Operational activity tracking and visit documentation.
Laboratory and samples
  • Sample identification, processing, storage and shipment.
  • Laboratory results and biohazardous waste management.
Investigational product
  • Receipt, storage, cold-chain control and temperature records.
  • Administration, accountability, transfer and reconciliation.
Documentation available for evaluation

Specific procedures and records may be presented during site evaluation according to the protocol scope and applicable confidentiality arrangements.
